body.text: Please confirm suggested API: add_task(path, title), list_tasks(path, include_done=False), complete_task(path, task_id). I propose TaskStoreError(ValueError) for validation/missing IDs/corrupt DB; CLI catches ValueError and OSError for useful stderr without tracebacks. Storage accepts str/PathLike paths, requires positive integer task_id (bool invalid), and persists {"tasks": [{"id": 1, "title": "trimmed", "done": false}], "next_id": 2} with strict validation and atomic replacement. Missing DB list returns []; complete on missing ID fails without creating DB. Agree, or propose changes before both contracts freeze?
